tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, secondary buttons: anything that sits on top of the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table stripes, neutral badges, hover on secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, captions. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Not for text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand navy (light) / bright blue (dark): primary buttons, links, focus rings, selected states.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for primary badges, ghost-button hover and the focus halo. Text on it uses primary.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Secondary brand blue: the logo dot, illustration, charts, highlights. Not for text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Light sky tint for info callouts and decorative fields.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lemon highlight for rewards, milestones and the logo dot on navy. Never text; text on a lemon fill uses on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent (lemon) fill. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of accent badges and callouts.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive state text and icons.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error badges and banners.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (blue). Use slots in order, never cycled; past 8 series fold into "Other". Validated for color-blind separation on surface-raised.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (orange). Use slots in order, never cycled; past 8 series fold into "Other". Validated for color-blind separation on surface-raised.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (aqua). Use slots in order, never cycled; past 8 series fold into "Other". Validated for color-blind separation on surface-raised.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (yellow). Use slots in order, never cycled; past 8 series fold into "Other". Validated for color-blind separation on surface-raised.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (magenta). Use slots in order, never cycled; past 8 series fold into "Other". Validated for color-blind separation on surface-raised.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (green). Use slots in order, never cycled; past 8 series fold into "Other". Validated for color-blind separation on surface-raised.

tokens.name: chart-7
tokens.usage: Chart series 7 (violet). Use slots in order, never cycled; past 8 series fold into "Other". Validated for color-blind separation on surface-raised.

tokens.name: chart-8
tokens.usage: Chart series 8 (red). Use slots in order, never cycled; past 8 series fold into "Other". Validated for color-blind separation on surface-raised.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Codes, IDs, numbers that must line up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside buttons and between label and input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button side padding, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, the logo dot.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Use sparingly: only on the element that needs separating.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts: anything floating above the page.
